case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Thank you for working through the options with us. We value a reliable agreement. AS-14404 changed +5.92% from 2025-09 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2025-09, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). This driver alone does not establish your total cost. Please reconcile it with the other cost movements. Your supplied document states: for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled (part:370010) we propose to agree the price basis for the coming period, including a price adjustment clause based on AS-14404. Please let us know your view. (doc:20260922-70740-P18). Could you share a cost breakdown and explain which drivers affect this quotation? Any movement is conditional on the executable terms below.

Executable packages:
Package 1: Unit price (EUR): 5.0; Index clause: null; Payment (days): 90; Contract duration (months): 24
Package 2: Unit price (EUR): 4.92; Index clause: null; Payment (days): 14; Contract duration (months): 24
Package 3: Unit price (EUR): 5.0; Index clause: null; Payment (days): 90; Contract duration (months): 36

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We thank you for your detailed response and the proposed options. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Please note that for a 24-month contract duration, we must include an AS-14404 price adjustment clause, as a fixed price over this period is not feasible given raw material volatility. Our current offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Incorporating your preferred 14-day payment term and the index clause, we can offer a revised unit price of €5.60. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit, a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.
